title: Yogāsana Vijñāna
author: Dhirendra Brahmachari
edition: User-supplied Russian EPUB; translator, publisher and publication year not verified.
locatorPolicy: Section heading and EPUB image identifier. Reflowable EPUB has no stable printed pagination.
metadataNote: The EPUB metadata says 1953, while its foreword is dated 29 December 1966. The metadata date is not used as the publication date.

entries.name: Siddhasana
entries.summary: An upright seat with one heel in front of the other; the plates show several hand and gaze variants.

entries.name: Padmasana
entries.summary: Both feet rest on opposite thighs. The book illustrates hands in the lap and hands on the knees.

entries.name: Bhadrasana
entries.summary: A kneeling seat on the heels, with hands on the thighs or reaching behind to the toes.
entries.comparison: The book shows a kneeling seat; the HYP study uses joined feet with open knees.

entries.name: Muktasana
entries.summary: An upright crossed-leg seat, with relaxed arms and hands resting on the knees.

entries.name: Vajrasana
entries.summary: Knees and shins rest on the ground, the pelvis rests on the heels and hands lie on the thighs.

entries.name: Svastikasana
entries.summary: The feet are tucked between the opposite calves and thighs in an upright seated shape.

entries.name: Simhasana
entries.summary: The knees spread and the body sits over raised heels, supported on the toes; hands rest on the knees.
entries.comparison: The book shows a toe-supported squat with heels together; the HYP study uses crossed ankles.

entries.name: Gomukhasana
entries.summary: Folded legs accompany a behind-the-back hand clasp, with one elbow raised and the other lowered.
entries.comparison: The book explicitly shows a behind-the-back arm clasp. That clasp is not specified in the HYP verse used for the existing study.

entries.name: Virasana
entries.summary: A long lunge with the front knee bent and the rear leg extended; one arm reaches forward at shoulder height and the other bends behind the waist.
entries.comparison: The book shows a long lunge. The HYP study interprets a foot-on-thigh seat.

entries.name: Dhanurasana
entries.summary: The legs pass over the head while the shoulders remain down; both hands reach to the toes.
entries.comparison: The book shows straight legs overhead in a shoulder-supported fold. The HYP study shows a seated archer configuration, which this book covers separately under Akarna-dhanurasana.

entries.name: Shavasana
entries.summary: The body rests lengthwise on the back, with arms alongside the torso and legs extended.

entries.name: Guptasana
entries.summary: A compact folded-leg seat with the feet tucked beneath the thighs.

entries.name: Matsyasana
entries.summary: The lotus legs remain folded while the chest arches upward and the head rests behind the shoulders.

entries.name: Matsyendrasana
entries.summary: The book shows an initial leg arrangement followed by a seated trunk rotation and arm wrap.
entries.comparison: Compare the foot hold and arm wrap closely: the current 3D study simplifies those contacts.

entries.name: Goraksasana
entries.summary: The feet meet beneath the pelvis, knees open to the sides and hands rest on the knees.

entries.name: Paschimottanasana
entries.summary: Both legs extend along the ground; the trunk folds toward them and the hands hold the feet.

entries.name: Utkatasana
entries.summary: A deep squat balances on the toes with raised heels and hands held in front.

entries.name: Sankatasana
entries.summary: One leg winds around the supporting leg while the palms join above the head.

entries.name: Mayurasana
entries.summary: The plates progress from a kneeling setup to a horizontal hand balance, including several leg variations.

entries.name: Kukkutasana
entries.summary: The arms pass through the folded lotus legs and the palms support the raised body.

entries.name: Kurmasana
entries.summary: The body sits on the heels and inclines forward, with bent elbows drawn into the abdomen.
entries.comparison: The book shows a forward-inclined kneeling seat with elbows at the abdomen. The HYP study uses a compact crossed-ankle seat.

entries.name: Uttana-kurmasana
entries.summary: A folded kneeling shape reclines into a backbend, with the crown down and the hands along the thighs.
entries.comparison: The book reclines from kneeling with hands on thighs. The HYP study reclines with folded lotus legs and hands behind the neck.

entries.name: Uttana-mandukasana
entries.summary: The section first shows the kneeling preparation, then a reclined kneeling backbend with the arms extended behind the head.

entries.name: Vrksasana
entries.summary: This section illustrates handstands and their preparations, including straight, folded and split legs.

entries.name: Mandukasana
entries.summary: The chest inclines forward over the kneeling legs, with the elbows drawn behind the trunk.

entries.name: Garudasana
entries.summary: One leg crosses the standing leg; the elbows bend and the forearms intertwine in front of the chest.

entries.name: Vrsabhasana
entries.summary: The body rests low over asymmetrically folded legs, supported by the forearms.

entries.name: Salabhasana
entries.summary: From a face-down position, the legs extend upward behind the pelvis while the chest remains low.

entries.name: Makarasana
entries.summary: The body lies face down, arms extending toward the head and legs lengthened behind.

entries.name: Ustrasana
entries.summary: In this book the body lies face down, knees bent, with the hands holding the feet behind the back.

entries.name: Bhujangasana
entries.summary: Palms support the lifted chest while the pelvis and extended legs remain near the ground.

entries.name: Yogasana
entries.summary: A lotus seat with hands in the lap is followed by a forward fold with the arms behind the back.

entries.name: Chakrasana
entries.summary: Hands and feet support a high backward arch, with the abdomen facing upward.

entries.name: Supta-pavana-muktasana
entries.summary: One knee is drawn toward the chest while the opposite leg extends along the ground.

entries.name: Uttanapadasana
entries.summary: The straight legs lift together while the head and upper trunk also rise slightly from the floor.

entries.name: Hasta-padangusthasana
entries.russian: ХАСТАПАДАНГУШТАСАНА (поза с захватом большого пальца ноги)
entries.summary: A raised straight leg is held by the hand, with forward and outward-facing variations.

entries.name: Baddha-padmasana
entries.summary: Lotus legs accompany a behind-the-back toe hold; a second plate shows the forward fold.

entries.name: Pranavasana
entries.summary: Both legs fold behind the shoulders while the trunk rests back and the palms join at the chest.

entries.name: Naukasana
entries.summary: The chest, arms and straight legs lift away from the floor in a face-down body extension.

entries.name: Konasana
entries.summary: The feet spread apart, the trunk bends sideways, one hand reaches to the foot and the other arm extends overhead in the same direction.

entries.name: Bhonomonasana
entries.summary: The legs spread along the floor as the chest lowers between them and hands reach toward the feet.

entries.name: Sarvangasana
entries.summary: This section shows the legs extending overhead toward the floor, with the shoulders supporting the trunk.

entries.name: Akarna-dhanurasana
entries.summary: One leg stays extended while the other foot draws toward the ear, both feet held by the hands.

entries.name: Urdhva-hastottanasana
entries.summary: The hands join above the head and the standing trunk bends sideways.

entries.name: Parvatasana
entries.summary: In the primary picture, folded lotus legs balance over the knees while the arms extend overhead.

entries.name: Padangusthasana
entries.summary: A deeply folded leg arrangement balances over one forefoot with the other foot resting above it.

entries.name: Garbhasana
entries.summary: The arms thread through the lotus legs; the illustrations show hands at the feet and beside the face.

entries.name: Brahmacharyasana
entries.summary: The pelvis rests between the folded legs with the feet turned outward and hands on the knees.

entries.name: Utthita-padmasana
entries.summary: The palms press into the floor beside the hips, raising the folded lotus body.

entries.name: Mrgasana
entries.summary: The primary picture shows one foot planted in front and the other leg folded back; one hand supports the cheek and the other rests on the raised knee.

entries.name: Pavanamuktasana
entries.summary: One or both bent knees are held close to the chest in a low seated or squatting position.

entries.name: Urdhva-sarvangasana
entries.summary: The legs rise together above the trunk while the hands support the back.

entries.name: Vikatasana
entries.summary: The knees spread in a seated shape while the soles turn upward beside the pelvis.

entries.name: Sirsachakrasana
entries.russian: ШИРШАЧАКРАСАНА (поза колеса с опорой на голову)
entries.summary: The feet and head support a deep backward arch, with the palms near the head.

entries.name: Avatthasana
entries.summary: One leg reaches backward, one arm rises overhead and the opposite arm extends sideways.

entries.name: Kandapidasana
entries.summary: The feet turn upward toward the abdomen while the knees open and remain low.

entries.name: Ardha-matsyendrasana
entries.summary: One foot crosses the opposite leg and the trunk turns toward the raised knee.

entries.name: Bakasana
entries.summary: The palms support the body while the knees fold against the upper arms and the feet lift behind.

entries.name: Titibhasana
entries.summary: Both legs extend around the shoulders in a hand-supported balance; the section includes a toe-holding variant.

entries.name: Viparita-sirsa-dvihasta-baddhasana
entries.russian: ВИПАРИТА-ШИРША-ДВИХАСТА БАДДХАСАНА (перевёрнутая поза, с ручным замком)
entries.summary: A standing forward fold accompanies an arm bind near or behind the head.

entries.name: Jhulasana
entries.summary: The folded seated legs hover above the ground, supported by upright forearms and hands.

entries.name: Sukhasana
entries.summary: A relaxed upright crossed-leg seat with the hands resting together in the lap.

entries.name: Janu-sirsasana
entries.summary: One leg extends while the other folds inward; the trunk lowers along the extended leg.

entries.name: Nadi-sodhanasana
entries.summary: With the feet close together, the trunk folds forward and hands reach near the ankles.

entries.name: Vistra-pada-sarvangasana
entries.summary: The shoulders support the body as the straight legs extend apart overhead.

entries.name: Ekapada-bhujasana
entries.russian: ЭКАПАДА БХУДЖАСАНА (одностороннее положение с рукой на ноге)
entries.summary: One leg crosses high over an arm while the other extends forward, supported on the palms.

entries.name: Dvipada-bhujasana
entries.russian: ДВИПАДА БХУДЖАСАНА (двухстороннее положения ноги на плече)
entries.summary: Both knees fold over the shoulders while the palms support the lifted body.

entries.name: Sirsa-janu-sparsasana
entries.russian: ШИРШАДЖАНУ СПАРШАСАНА (Наклон с ксанием головой колена)
entries.summary: The trunk folds over a straight supporting leg while the other knee bends, bringing that heel toward the buttock for a two-hand hold.

entries.name: Supta-vrscikasana
entries.summary: From a prone backbend, the bent legs reach toward the chin while the arms spread sideways along the ground.

entries.name: Utthita-dvipada-kandarasana
entries.russian: УТТХИТА ДВИПАДА КАНДАРАСАНА (положение с двумя ногами за головой)
entries.summary: Both feet fold behind the head; the plates show a hand-supported lift and a seated arm variation.

entries.name: Tadasana
entries.summary: The arms extend overhead as the body rises over the toes, with straight and arched variations.

entries.name: Khanjanasana
entries.summary: The plates pair a wide-kneed upright position with a forward hand-supported crouch.

entries.name: Ekahasta-bhujasana
entries.summary: One bent leg rises beside the shoulder while a hand holds the lifted foot.

entries.name: Dvihasta-bhujasana
entries.russian: ДВИХАСТА БХУДЖАСАНА (положение обеих рук на плечах)
entries.summary: Both knees draw beside the upper arms and the hands hold the raised feet.

entries.name: Janu-bhumi-sthirasana
entries.summary: The torso rises over separated knees, hands resting behind the hips.

entries.name: Padahastasana
entries.summary: The trunk folds over straight standing legs, with the hands reaching under or beside the feet.

entries.name: Ekapada-kandarasana
entries.summary: One foot folds behind the neck while the opposite leg folds inward or extends forward.

entries.name: Dvipada-kandapidasana
entries.russian: ДВИПАДА-КАНДАПИДАСАНА (положение с двумя ногами за головой)
entries.summary: Both legs fold behind the shoulders with the feet raised above the head and the hands joining in front.

entries.name: Bhagasana
entries.summary: The soles face upward between spread knees while the trunk remains upright.

entries.name: Udara-karsanasana
entries.russian: УДАРА-КАРШАНАСАНА (положение создающее всасывающий эффект в животе)
entries.summary: A low squat turns toward one side as one knee lowers across toward the opposite foot.

entries.name: Tolangulasana
entries.summary: The section pairs a seated straight-leg hand balance with an extended prone lifting shape.

entries.name: Purvottanasana
entries.summary: Both straight legs lift in front of the seated trunk and the hands hold the toes.

entries.name: Dvipada-vistrasana
entries.summary: The legs spread into a wide seated split with upright, side-fold and forward-fold variations.

entries.name: Sirsasana
entries.summary: The plates show head placement, folded-leg preparations, upright headstand and leg variations.

entries.name: Supta-pada-kandarasana
entries.russian: СУПТА-ПАДА-КАНДАРАСАНА (положение лежа с ногой за головой)
entries.summary: One leg folds behind the neck while the other extends forward along the floor.

entries.name: Katichakrasana
entries.summary: The trunk rotates with both arms extending around shoulder height.

entries.name: Pretasana
entries.summary: An upright seated shape with knees open and the feet joined in front of the pelvis.

entries.name: Pada-skanda-dandasana
entries.russian: ПАДА-СКАНДА-ДАНДАСАНА (положение посоха с ногой за головой)
entries.summary: One leg folds behind the shoulder across several hand-supported, extended and reclined shapes.

entries.name: Supta-vajrasana
entries.summary: The lower legs remain folded back while the trunk reclines into a deep arch.

entries.name: Vistra-pada-vaksa-bhumi-sparsasana
entries.summary: The legs spread sideways and the chest lowers to the ground between them.

entries.name: Kakasana
entries.summary: A compact squat with feet together and the hands resting on the knees.

entries.name: Lolasana
entries.summary: The rounded trunk and tucked legs lift between the arms, supported by both palms.

entries.name: Supta-padangustha-nasa-sparsasana
entries.russian: СУПТА-ПАДАНГУШТА-НАСА-СПАРШАСАНА (положение касания пальца ноги носа, лёжа)
entries.summary: One straight leg rises toward the face while the hands hold the foot; the other leg extends outward.

entries.name: Karna-pidasana
entries.summary: The bent knees lower beside the ears while the shoulders and arms remain grounded.

entries.name: Meru-dandasana
entries.summary: The primary picture shows raised knees beside the shoulders and feet held under the chin; another picture shows a deeper forward fold.

entries.name: Padangustha-nasa-sparsasana
entries.russian: ПАДАНГУШТА-НАСА-СПАРШАСАНА (положение с касанием носом пальца ноги)
entries.summary: From a long staggered stance, the trunk folds toward the front foot while the hands clasp behind the back.

entries.name: Kalabhairavasana
entries.summary: Both feet remain grounded in a staggered stance. One arm reaches forward and the other backward; the text also describes the gaze and open mouth.

entries.name: Catuskonasana
entries.summary: One leg folds behind the shoulder and the opposite leg bends back beside the hip.

entries.name: Kukilasana
entries.summary: The knees spread and the forearms fold together low in front of the trunk.

entries.name: Vrscikasana
entries.summary: Forearm-supported and hand-supported inversions curve the bent legs toward the head.

entries.name: Takyasana
entries.summary: The plates show an asymmetric side-supported balance and a folded seated variation.

entries.name: Mayura-padmasana
entries.summary: The horizontal peacock balance retains folded lotus legs behind the trunk.

entries.name: Purna-chakrasana
entries.summary: The book describes the feet walking around planted hands. Its picture shows an intermediate turn, with one knee bent and the other leg extended.

entries.name: Paksyasana
entries.russian: ПАКСЬЯСАНА ИЛИ ВАЮЯНАСАНА (положение птицы или самолета)
entries.summary: A single-leg balance with the other foot drawn behind the head and arms extended sideways.

entries.name: Vatayanasana
entries.summary: One leg folds into a half-lotus shape while the body balances over the other bent leg and one knee.

entries.name: Ardha-urdhvasana
entries.summary: One leg extends upward behind the body as the trunk inclines and one arm reaches forward.

entries.name: Tribandhasana
entries.summary: A lotus seat with straight arms and lowered chin, presented in the text with the three locks.

entries.name: Natarajasana
entries.summary: Six plates show distinct dance-like balances with raised knees, overhead arms and deep leg lifts.

entries.name: Surya-namaskar
entries.summary: Twelve illustrations document the book's sequence; use their displayed order rather than a substituted modern sequence.
